extracted.intended_audience: readers of Esquire and potential contributors/advertisers interested in the magazine's editorial practices
extracted.subtask_description: A publication masthead describing Esquire's editorial policies, staff roles, and reader-facing practices (accuracy, disclosures, privacy, and contact). Useful for understanding the magazine's standards for content, product recommendations, and transparency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accuracy
rubrics_metrics.description: What we publish at Esquire isn't just fun—or funny, gripping, uplifting, shocking, or enlightening—it's also thoroughly edited and fact-checked for accuracy, clarity, and fairness.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If we’re recommending a pair of sneakers, the best TV shows to watch this year, or the best and brightest tech and gifts, you can bet that we’ve researched, evaluated, or, in some cases, consulted style, tech, and industry experts to clue us in on the latest insights, analysis, and best-in-class products.

rubrics_metrics.name: Affiliate disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Yep, we participate in affiliate marketing programs, which means we may get paid a commission when you buy something recommended on our site.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: However, anything that runs on Esquire is thoroughly vetted by our editors. We only recommend products that we, the editors, truly stand behind. The merchandise we feature on our site is always driven by editorial standards, not by affiliate deals or advertising relationships.

rubrics_metrics.name: Privacy
rubrics_metrics.description: We take our trusted relationship with our readers seriously, and therefore maintain a strict privacy policy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Readers are directed to the site's privacy settings and choices (e.g., 'Your Privacy Choices') and the publication emphasizes protecting reader information as part of its relationship with the audience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact & reader communication
rubrics_metrics.description: Contact Us: Email us! We're at esquirestaff@hearst.com. Or Tweet us. DM us on Instagram. TikTok? We're on it.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you have a question about something you read or your subscription, hit us wherever makes sense for you. (If you're interested in subscribing or signing up for our daily newsletter, follow those links.) This conveys an explicit channel for feedback, queries, and potential corrections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editorial transparency / Staff masthead
rubrics_metrics.description: Names and roles of editorial leadership and staff are published (e.g., Editor in Chief, Executive Editor, Style Director, Commerce Director, etc.), along with contributors and editors at large.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Publishing a detailed masthead provides accountability and transparency about who is responsible for editorial, art, fashion, copy, research, and other functions on the site.
